hook: Never overpay at a card show
caption:
🛠️ Never overpay at a card show? Here's a free tool for it

Want list on market.driveyourstyle.net (link in bio):
1. Tap ♥ on any card to add it to your Want list
2. Set the most you'd pay
3. Pull it up at a show or shop to know a good deal on the spot

Free, no sign-up. Pokémon, One Piece, Lorcana, Riftbound and 6 more games, prices updated every night.
Save this for your next card show 🔖
